title: NY State Assembly · District 77
area: The West Bronx, including Highbridge and surrounding neighborhoods.

context.text: Uncontested race. Incumbent Landon Dais advanced from the Democratic primary unopposed after Shakur Joseph withdrew or was disqualified; no Republican candidate qualified for the general-election ballot.

candidates.name: Landon Dais
candidates.currentRole: NY State Assembly Member, District 77 (since February 2024)

summary.text: Landon Dais is the unopposed Democratic incumbent seeking a first full term after winning a February 2024 special election. An attorney and Bronx community advocate, he sits on the Banks, Cities, Economic Development, Energy, Housing and Small Business committees and campaigns on affordable housing, street safety, senior services and youth investment.

background.text: Born and raised in New York and lives in Highbridge in the Bronx.
Earned a B.A. in business management from Morehouse College, an M.S. in real estate development from Columbia University, and a J.D. from Hofstra Law School.

Worked as an attorney representing small businesses and non-profits, and has worked in the cannabis industry on marijuana legalization, workforce development and criminal justice reform issues; received the Pro-Bono Attorney of the Year award from Touro College's Jacob D. Fuchsberg Law Center for his work on marijuana arrests, and the NAACP Roy Wilkins Award.
Before law, served as a Deputy Director at the Police Athletic League and worked at Turner Construction, including on the new Yankee Stadium project.
Serves on the board of the Mid Bronx Desperadoes (MBD), focusing on affordable housing in the Bronx, and leads the Highbridge Heights Homeowners Association.

priorities.text: Economic development, investing in youth, access to healthcare, vocational training, and immigration.

record.text: Assembly committee assignments for 2025-2026: Banks, Cities, Economic Development/Job Creation/Commerce and Industry, Energy, Housing, and Small Business.
Won a February 14, 2024 special election to the Assembly, succeeding Latoya Joyner.

sources.title: Landon Dais for NY Assembly — District 77

researchNotes: No opposing candidate qualified for the November 3, 2026 general-election ballot in this district. Dais has not completed Ballotpedia's Candidate Connection survey; his campaign site lists priority topics without detailed issue statements, so no sourced positions with stated stances could be documented for the ISSUES list.
